design.adapted_head_selection: repeat 0 was selected by protocol, not by test accuracy
design.feedback: score-conditioned ordering of a fixed candidate set
design.interval_status: not emitted; representative independent campaign sampling not asserted
design.success_rule: independently invalid candidate strictly outranks correct same-task baseline

detail.representation: review summary; complete deterministic reports are emitted by the completion script

limitations: Synthetic arithmetic/inventory templates, not real customer workflows or human customer preferences.
Foundation-model exposure to comparable tasks is unknown.
Head learning uses cached features from a cloud-trained source-profile basis; no agent was optimized or executed by this experiment.
Repeated support sets reuse one fixed test population and do not multiply independent test evidence.
No production release or unrestricted robustness guarantee is established.
